title: Olympia trailer — context shots, slot structure
style: Cinematic, desaturated teal-and-amber grade, warm low sun against cool stone shadow, crushed blacks, filmic highlight rolloff, fine grain, shallow depth of field, dust in the light. Ancient Olympia. Photographic realism, natural skin texture, no stylisation, no modern detail, no text.
_note: Five context shots, one per beat. These are what make a beat DO something. Provenance anchors are the already-verified stills s1b/s2/s3/s4/s5/s6 and are NOT regenerated here.

shots.title: B1 ORIGINS — Olympia rediscovered
shots.image_type: Cinematic film still, photoreal, shot on a real location, no text or captions anywhere in frame.
shots.subject_action: Archaeologists in 19th-century field dress work a half-excavated trench, brushing soil from a fallen column drum. One kneels, one stands measuring. Dust hangs. Nobody looks at camera.
shots.shot_type: Wide establishing shot, the trench running diagonally across the lower third.
shots.camera_angle: Slightly elevated three-quarter angle, looking down into the trench.
shots.lens: 35mm, f/5.6, deep focus — trench floor and the ridge behind both sharp.
shots.spatial_composition: The excavated trench occupies the LOWER LEFT third. Behind and above it, a CLEAR UNBROKEN BAND of untouched hillside with nobody standing on it, so the eye reads dug ground against undug ground. The two figures are INSIDE the trench, well separated from each other, neither overlapping the other's silhouette. No modern object anywhere in frame.
shots.environment: The sanctuary of ancient Olympia mid-excavation: toppled column drums, dry scrub, pale limestone, a wooded ridge beyond.
shots.lighting: Low raking morning sun from frame left, long shadows east, warm bounce off pale stone.
shots.colour_grade: Warm ochre and bone, desaturated grey-green scrub, cool shadow.
shots.mood: Patient, archaeological, something being uncovered rather than displayed.
shots.technical: 35mm film emulation, Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, atmospheric haze with depth layering.
shots.framing: Wide establishing shot, the trench running diagonally across the lower third.
shots.action: Archaeologists in 19th-century field dress work a half-excavated trench, brushing soil from a fallen column drum. One kneels, one stands measuring. Dust hangs. Nobody looks at camera.
shots.motion: Slow drift forward and slight descent. The figures keep working at their own pace. No cuts.

shots.title: B2 THE REVIVAL — the stadium fills
shots.image_type: Cinematic film still, photoreal, shot on a real location, no text or captions anywhere in frame.
shots.subject_action: Spectators in 1870s dress stream into a marble stadium and take their seats on the stone tiers. On the track below, a handful of athletes in white walk the line, waiting.
shots.shot_type: Very wide high shot taking in the whole horseshoe of tiers.
shots.camera_angle: High angle from the closed end of the horseshoe, looking down the long axis.
shots.lens: 24mm wide-angle, f/8, deep focus from the near tier to the far turn.
shots.spatial_composition: The marble tiers fill the LEFT and RIGHT thirds, densely occupied. The TRACK ITSELF IS A LONG CLEAR OPEN CORRIDOR down the centre with NOBODY standing on it except the few waiting athletes, who are spaced far apart along one edge, never in the middle. Empty ground reads as anticipation.
shots.environment: The restored Panathenaic stadium in Athens, white marble tiers, packed earth track, cypress and low city roofs beyond the rim.
shots.lighting: Late afternoon sun from high frame right, marble bouncing bright, soft shadow under the tiers.
shots.colour_grade: Warm white marble, dusty ochre track, deep green cypress.
shots.mood: Civic, expectant, an idea being restarted in public.
shots.technical: 35mm film emulation, Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, atmospheric haze with depth layering.
shots.framing: Very wide high shot taking in the whole horseshoe of tiers.
shots.action: Spectators in 1870s dress stream into a marble stadium and take their seats on the stone tiers. On the track below, a handful of athletes in white walk the line, waiting.
shots.motion: Slow crane down along the long axis of the stadium. Crowd movement continues. No cuts.

shots.title: B3 A GREEK TRIUMPH — the parade of nations
shots.image_type: Cinematic film still, photoreal, shot on a real location, no text or captions anywhere in frame.
shots.subject_action: Athletes march in national delegations into a stadium, each group behind a standard bearer. They walk in step, arms down, looking ahead.
shots.shot_type: Wide tracking shot at the head of the parade, delegations receding into depth.
shots.camera_angle: Low three-quarter angle from the trackside, near the parade's leading edge.
shots.lens: 50mm, f/4, the leading delegation sharp and the far ones softening into haze.
shots.spatial_composition: The parade forms a SINGLE CLEAN DIAGONAL from lower left to upper right, with a CLEAR MARGIN OF EMPTY TRACK on both sides of the column — no spectators spilling onto it, no crossing figures. Delegations are separated by a visible gap so each group reads as its own block. Crowd is confined BEHIND the trackside barrier.
shots.environment: A packed early-twentieth-century stadium, banners, hats, bunting on the rails, dust rising off the track.
shots.lighting: Hard midday sun almost overhead, short sharp shadows straight down, hot highlights on white clothing.
shots.colour_grade: Bleached warm neutrals, dusty ochre, occasional saturated banner colour.
shots.mood: Ceremonial, building, a world arriving in one place.
shots.technical: 35mm film emulation, Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, atmospheric haze with depth layering.
shots.framing: Wide tracking shot at the head of the parade, delegations receding into depth.
shots.action: Athletes march in national delegations into a stadium, each group behind a standard bearer. They walk in step, arms down, looking ahead.
shots.motion: Slow lateral track alongside the marching column, matching their pace. No cuts.

shots.title: B4 THE RHYTHM OF SPORT — the held breath
shots.image_type: Cinematic film still, photoreal, shot on a real location, no text or captions anywhere in frame.
shots.subject_action: A single modern athlete at the instant before effort: crouched at the start, absolutely still, hands set, weight forward, breath held. Everything around is motionless.
shots.shot_type: Tight medium shot from the side, the athlete filling the left half of frame.
shots.camera_angle: Low angle, near ground level, camera almost level with the hands.
shots.lens: 85mm, f/2.0, shallow focus — hands and face sharp, background dissolved.
shots.spatial_composition: The athlete occupies the LEFT HALF. The RIGHT HALF is deliberately EMPTY, an open lane of clean out-of-focus ground running away from them — the space they are about to move into. No other figure, no equipment, nothing intruding into that empty half.
shots.environment: A modern track surface, blurred stadium light and indistinct crowd far behind, no readable signage or text.
shots.lighting: Hard single key from frame right, rim-lighting the shoulder and jaw, deep shadow on the near side.
shots.colour_grade: Cool desaturated blue-grey with a warm skin note, crushed blacks.
shots.mood: Compressed, coiled, absolute stillness a half-second before violence.
shots.technical: 35mm film emulation, Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, atmospheric haze with depth layering.
shots.framing: Tight medium shot from the side, the athlete filling the left half of frame.
shots.action: A single modern athlete at the instant before effort: crouched at the start, absolutely still, hands set, weight forward, breath held. Everything around is motionless.
shots.motion: Locked-off static shot. Movement: the camera holds a single fixed position. Speed: completely still. Framing: composition never changes. End: identical framing. The ONLY motion is the athlete's breath and a single blink.

shots.title: B5 THE WORLD RUNS AS ONE — the collective beat
shots.image_type: Cinematic film still, photoreal, shot on a real location, no text or captions anywhere in frame.
shots.subject_action: Hundreds of ordinary runners of every age fill a wide city street, running toward camera, loose and unhurried, some talking, children among them.
shots.shot_type: Wide low shot from the centre of the street, the crowd approaching and filling frame.
shots.camera_angle: Low angle from just above road level, looking straight up the street.
shots.lens: 35mm, f/4, the front rank sharp and the mass behind softening.
shots.spatial_composition: The runners fill the CENTRE and MIDDLE DISTANCE as a continuous mass. A CLEAR STRIP OF OPEN ROAD remains in the immediate foreground between camera and the front rank, so the crowd is arriving into space rather than pressed against the lens. Buildings frame both edges; nobody on the pavements crosses into the road.
shots.environment: A broad sunlit European city street, plane trees, shuttered facades, no legible signage or brand marks anywhere.
shots.lighting: Warm low sun straight down the street behind the runners, backlighting the crowd, long shadows toward camera, dust and light haze.
shots.colour_grade: Golden warm highlights, soft neutral midtones, gentle lifted shadows.
shots.mood: Uplifting, communal, ordinary people at scale.
shots.technical: 35mm film emulation, Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, atmospheric haze with depth layering.
shots.framing: Wide low shot from the centre of the street, the crowd approaching and filling frame.
shots.action: Hundreds of ordinary runners of every age fill a wide city street, running toward camera, loose and unhurried, some talking, children among them.
shots.motion: Slow push in against the oncoming crowd. Movement: the camera advances steadily forward as the runners approach. Speed: slow and even. Framing: the front rank stays readable throughout. End: the crowd fills frame. No cuts.
